bio_en: Levon Shaghoyan was called 'Pasha' by his people in recognition of his work and its results. A man of the people, he devoted everything to the realisation of its ideals. In 1918 he led the self-defence fighting in Salmast with Samson and Kostia Hambardzumian against the invading Turkish army. He is remembered as a brilliant hero in the history of Armenian heroic struggles.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Dates not read; tribute by Hrand Margarian, Hairenik 1974.
